chapter.li: LEChapter9 Verse1 Then he called his twelve disciples together, and he gave them power and authority over all devils and to cure diseases. VerseEnd Verse2 And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick. VerseEnd Verse3 And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey — neither staves nor scrip, neither bread, neither money, neither have two coats apiece. VerseEnd Verse4 And into whatever house you enter, there abide until you depart VerseEnd Verse5 from there. And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them. VerseEnd Verse6 And they departed and went through the towns, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere. VerseEnd

Verse7 Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by Jesus, and he was perplexed because it was said of some that John was risen from the dead, VerseEnd Verse8 and of some that Elijah had appeared, and of others that one of the old prophets was risen again. VerseEnd Verse9 And Herod said, John have I beheaded, but who is this of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him. VerseEnd

Verse10 And the apostles, when they returned, told Jesus all that they had done. And he took them and went aside privately into a solitary place belonging to the city called Bethsaida. VerseEnd Verse11 And the people, when they knew it, followed him. And he received them and spoke unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them who had need of healing. VerseEnd Verse12 And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge and get provisions, for we are here in a solitary place. VerseEnd Verse13 But he said unto them, Give them to eat. And they said, We have but five loaves and two fishes, and except we should go and buy food, we can provide no more food for all this multitude VerseEnd (Verse14 for they were in number about five thousand men). And Jesus said unto his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company. VerseEnd Verse15 And they did so and made them all sit down. VerseEnd Verse16 Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to Heaven he blessed them, and broke, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude. VerseEnd Verse17 And they did eat and were all filled. And there were taken up of fragments which remained, twelve baskets. VerseEnd

Verse18 And it came to pass, as he went alone with his disciples to pray, he asked them, saying, Who do the people say that I am? VerseEnd Verse19 They answering said, Some say John the Baptist, but others say Elijah, and others that one of the old prophets is risen again. VerseEnd Verse20 He said unto them, But who do you say that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ, the Son of God. VerseEnd Verse21 And he forbade them, and commanded them to tell no man of him, VerseEnd Verse22 saying, The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and chief priests, and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day. VerseEnd Verse23 And he said unto them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. VerseEnd Verse24 For whoever will save his life must be willing to lose it for my sake. And whoever will be willing to lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it. VerseEnd Verse25 For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world and yet he receives him not whom God has ordained, and he lose his own soul, and he himself be a cast away? VerseEnd Verse26 For whoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of Man be ashamed when he shall come in his own kingdom, clothed in the glory of his Father with the holy angels. VerseEnd Verse27 Truly, I tell you truly, there are some standing here who shall not taste of death until they see the kingdom of God coming in power. VerseEnd

Verse28 And it came to pass, eight days after these sayings, that he took Peter, and John, and James, and went up into a mountain to pray. VerseEnd Verse29 And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was changed and his raiment became white and glittering. VerseEnd Verse30 And behold, there came and talked with him two men, even Moses and Elias, VerseEnd Verse31 who appeared in glory and spoke of his death and also his resurrection which he should accomplish at Jerusalem. VerseEnd Verse32 But Peter and they who were with him were heavy with sleep. And when they were awake, they saw his glory and the two men who stood with him. VerseEnd Verse33 And after the two men departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us make three tabernacles: one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elias — not knowing what he said. VerseEnd Verse34 While he thus spoke, there came a cloud and overshadowed them all, and they feared as they entered into the cloud. VerseEnd Verse35 And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my Beloved Son; hear him. VerseEnd Verse36 And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And these things they kept close, and they told no man in those days any of the things which they had seen. VerseEnd

Verse37 And it came to pass that on the next day, when they had come down from the hill, many people met him. VerseEnd Verse38 And behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I implore you, look upon my son, for he is my only child! VerseEnd Verse39 And behold, a spirit takes him, and he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him that he foams, and bruising him harshly, departs from him. VerseEnd Verse40 And I implored your disciples to cast him out and they could not. VerseEnd Verse41 And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and suffer you? Bring your son here. VerseEnd Verse42 And as he was coming, the devil threw him down and convulsed him again. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father. VerseEnd

Verse43 And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered, everyone, at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples, VerseEnd Verse44 Let these sayings sink down into your hearts, for the Son of Man shall be delivered into the hands of man. VerseEnd Verse45 But they understood not this saying, and it was hidden from them that they perceived it not; and they feared to ask him of that saying. VerseEnd

Verse46 Then there arose a reasoning among them: who of them should be greatest. VerseEnd Verse47 And Jesus, perceiving the thoughts of their hearts, took a child and set him in the midst. VerseEnd Verse48 And said unto them, Whoever shall receive this child in my name, receives me. And whoever shall receive me, receives him that sent me. For he who is least among you all, the same shall be great. VerseEnd

Verse49 And John spoke and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in your name, and we forbade him because he follows not with us. VerseEnd Verse50 And Jesus said unto him, Forbid not any, for he that is not against us is for us. VerseEnd
